scope: Same synthetic posture; replay automatic body, replay GT hips, and replace all 12 existing Sapiens body targets with GT. Other settings unchanged.
gt_usage: True Head pose and generating cameras in all fits. Hips/body cases also use the specified target GT coordinates in loss only. Body12 metrics in GT body condition are fitting accuracy, not held-out detection accuracy. Other13 includes constrained head/face and unobserved feet; no generalization claim.
evaluation: Absolute camera-space errors without alignment except explicitly pelvis/ankle-aligned fields. GT in-frame flags do not test occlusion.
